key.name: layout-json
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, and desktop positions as JSON.

key.name: edit-mode
key.description: Enable widget edit mode to move and remove widgets on the desktop.

key.name: custom-photo
key.description: Absolute path to a photo to display in the Photos widget instead of the automatic selection. Leave empty to use the automatic rotating photos.

key.name: photo-size
key.description: How the photo fits the widget: cover (fill and crop), contain (entire photo visible), fill (stretch), or small (centered). Allowed values: cover, contain, fill, small.

key.name: battery-icon-size
key.description: Size of the device icon inside each battery ring: small, medium, or large.

key.name: battery-slot-count
key.description: Maximum number of devices shown in the Battery widget.

key.name: battery-show-percent
key.description: Show the charge percentage below each battery ring.

key.name: arrange-widgets
key.description: Set to true to align all widgets into a shared grid of columns and rows. The extension performs the arrangement and resets the key to false.

key.name: music-ignore-browsers
key.description: Prevent browsers like Chrome or Firefox from taking over the music widget.

key.name: music-empty-gif
key.description: Animated GIF shown by the music widget when no track is playing. Allowed values: pushy.gif, pushy2.gif.

key.name: edit-mode-binding
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to toggle edit mode on the desktop. Leave empty to disable.

key.name: style-background
key.description: Custom CSS background color. Leave empty for default.

key.name: style-border-color
key.description: Custom CSS border color. Leave empty for default.

key.name: style-shadow
key.description: Custom CSS box shadow. Leave empty for default.

key.name: style-shadow-size
key.description: Blur radius of the custom box shadow in pixels.

key.name: style-widget-opacity
key.description: Global opacity of all desktop widgets, from 0.1 (nearly invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque).
